BiblicalUsage: Israel encamped before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, and the Jews in Egypt dwelt at Migdol and Tahpanhes and Noph. At Ezekiel the same word is the tower of Syene, where the land of Egypt will be made desolate. Migdol is the place on the edge of the sea, and the word is the tower itself as well.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Migdol stands at the edge of the Exodus for a reason: between Migdol and the sea, with Pharaoh behind and the water before, Israel learned that God makes a way where there is none.
